segments.text: One of the grandsons of the chairman of a major food company headquartered in Tokyo and the current president of the company. He is a man of medium height and medium build with a mild-mannered air about him but his nature is rotten and he takes pleasure in deceiving and playing tricks on others.

He spends his days in debauchery, begging not only his parents but also his grandfather for money. He has the cunning to take full advantage of his parents' and grandfather's money and status. He met Rina at a meeting with Tenjou Foods and fell in love with her at first sight. Since then, he has persistently asked Rina for a relationship, taking advantage of his superior position.

He was frustrated that Rina was not interested in him at all, but he took advantage of her father's illness to ask her to marry him. At first, he was delighted by Rina's voluptuous body and became addicted to her, but he began to get bored with her somewhat cold reaction and started to have lovers outside the house.

Rina was patient at first, but when he began to bring his mistresses into the house, she could not stand it any longer and moved out. They became separated, and since they had no children together, Rina asked for a divorce. However, Yasuhito did not agree to the divorce and continued to maintain their marital status.
From official site
東京に本社を置く大手食品会社の会長の孫の一人。現社長である桜田武仁（さくらだ　たけひと）の次男。
中肉中背の男性で温和そうな雰囲気を持った男性だが、その中身……性根は腐りきっていて、他人を騙し、弄ぶことに愉悦を感じる。
自身の立場を最大限に利用することで、若くしてサクナマイト本社のマーケット部の部長の地位に立っている。
親だけでなく祖父にも金銭をねだるなどして、放蕩三昧の日々を送っているが、親のすねをかじるだけのボンボンというわけではなく、親や祖父の金銭や地位を最大限に利用する狡猾さを持っている。
里奈とは天城フーズとの間で行われた協議の場で出会い一目惚れし、以後、立場が上であることを利用して執拗に交際を申しこむようになった。
里奈に全く相手にされず苛立ちを感じていたが、里奈の父の死を巧み利用し、里奈に求婚を申し出て強引に妻にさせた。
最初は里奈の豊満な身体に歓喜し、病み付きになるも、心ここにあらずといった里奈のどこか冷めた反応に飽き始め、外に愛人を作って遊び始めた。
愛人を複数作って夜遊びを繰り返していることに最初は我慢していた里奈だったが、愛人を家に連れ込むようになったことに耐えきれなくなり、康仁の家を出ていった。
別居状態となり、二人の間に子供がいなかったこともあり、里奈から離婚して欲しいと言われる。
しかし、康仁は嫌がらせとばかりに、離婚に同意せず、夫婦の状態を維持し続けている。

Nachi's boss, who graduated from university with excellent grades and has been employed at the Tokyo branch of Kirishima Heavy Industries. Although still young, he is a successful businessman who is the head of the Quality Control Department. He has an intuitive ability to recognize latent talent in others. He spots Nachi, who had just joined the company and is brimming with talent, and begins to favor him.

He is the grandson of Hayato Kirishima, the current CEO of Kirishima Heavy Industries, a global company. He is the third son of Onodera Takumi and Kirishima Mizuki. He is a super thoroughbred with a direct Kirishima bloodline, but due to his parents' policy and Takuto's own will, he joined the company on the basis of his ability alone, without the help of his familial connections.

Takuto's fearless personality and business acumen were on full display soon after he joined the company, and he quickly made a name for himself, he was transferred to the Quality Control Department of the Tokyo Branch Office, where he demonstrated his overwhelming talent to the fullest. He was selected as a department manager in his fifth year with the company.
His grandfather Hayato Kirishima, invited him to work at the head office in the Kozuma region, but he turned down the invitation, saying he had not won the position by his ability.

He has a friendly personality without being arrogant, and he and Nachi have more of a brother-brother relationship than a boss-subordinate relationship. He is an important figure who will influence the future of Nachi and Rina, Nachi's love interest.
From official site
優れた成績で大学を卒業し、霧島重工の東京支社へ就職した那智の上司。
まだ若いが品質管理部の部長を努めているやり手のサラリーマン。
他人が潜在的に持っている才能を見抜く、直感のような力を持っていて、入社したばかりの才気に溢れる那智に目を付け、重用するようになる。
父方の名字を名乗り、本人も決して口にしないが、世界に名だたるグローバル企業である霧島重工の現ＣＥＯである霧島隼人の孫――「あねいも２」の主人公と小野寺拓己と、ヒロイン霧島深月の三男。
霧島家直系の血筋を持つスーパーサラブレッドだが、両親の方針と拓斗自身の意志もあり、霧島の血筋の力を借りることなく実力のみで入社。
物怖じしない性格と持ち前の商才を入社早々に発揮し、頭角を現すと、東京支社の商品管理部に転属し、その圧倒的なまでの才能をいかんなく発揮し、入社５年目で部長に抜擢された。
兄弟の中でも商才の部分は飛び抜けて優れていて、祖父でありＣＥＯを努める霧島隼人から、上妻地方にある本社に勤務するように誘われているが、実力で勝ち取ったことにならないと、隼永の誘いを断っている。
決して偉ぶることない気さくな性格で、那智とは上司と部下というより、兄貴と弟のような関係を築いている。
那智と、那智の想い人である里奈の未来を左右することになる重要人物。
Nachi's father. A junior colleague of Rina's father's at university, he was the head of the product development department of Tenjou Foods.

He is a calm and collected man who cared about his colleagues and subordinates, and was trusted by Rina's father, the president. However, he was unable to take effective measures in the face of a far greater-than-expected recession. As a result, he regrets his inability to do anything about the situation and is acutely aware of his own inability to do anything about it.

He is deeply regretful of his inability to do anything about the situation, and is painfully aware of his own power. He understands Nachi's feelings after Rina's disappearance, and despite the opposition and concerns of those around him, Nachi devoted himself to his studies and the dojo, and he watches Nachi's actions without saying a word.

In order to help Nachi, who had decided to go to Tokyo to look for Rina, he visited Tokyo several times over the weekend and obtained information on his own, and told him that Rina was still living in Tokyo and that she had married the third son of the president of Sakunamite.
Nachi, who was indeed upset about her marriage to the third son but still wanted to see Rina with a strong will in his eyes, agreed to go to Tokyo.
From official site
那智の父親。里奈の父の大学時代の後輩で、天城フーズの商品開発部の部長を努めていた。
沈着冷静ながらも、同僚や部下を大切にする人間味のある人物で、天城フーズの社長……里奈の父からの信頼も厚かったが、予想を遙かに上回る大不況の前に有効な手を打つことが出来なかった。
結果してサクナマイトに騙される形で、流通網だけ奪われ倒産に追い込まれてしまった事に、何も出来なかったことを後悔し己の力のなさを痛感している。
里奈がいなくなり、周囲の反対や心配もよそに、学業と道場にひたすら入れ込む那智の気持ちに理解を示し、那智の行動を何も言わずに見守ることにした。
里奈を探すために東京行きを決めた那智の力添えになればと、週末に何度か東京へと足を運び、独自に手に入れた情報……上京した里奈がまだ東京に住んでいること、言いたくはないがと前置きしつつ、サクナマイトの社長の三男と結婚したことを伝える。
三男との結婚にさすがに狼狽しつつも強い意志のこもった目で、それでも里奈に会いたい、と答える那智の言葉を受け、思う存分、自分が納得するまでやってこい、と言って東京行きを快諾した。
Nachi's mother. She works with her husband Satoshi in the Product Development Department of Tenjou Foods, and has always supported him at work.

She has a strong personality and is well-known for her ability to get things done at work, but she is not a cold-hearted career woman at all, but rather a warm-hearted person who motivates others. She sometimes worries that she could not take care of her son Nachi because she and her husband were both working, but Rina, the daughter of the president of Tenjou Foods and a neighbor, took care of Nachi, so she continued to work with her husband even though she felt sorry for him.

Rina, who had often come to visit Nachi, was like a daughter to her, and she had strong trust in her, feeling safe leaving her only son, Nachi, in her care. The couple had been active together, but when Tenjou Foods went bankrupt, they decided to quit their jobs and devote themselves to housework. Nachi devotes himself to his studies and martial arts as if he were possessed by something.
From official site
那智の母親。夫である智史と共に天城フーズの商品開発部に務め、職場でも夫である智史を支え続けてきた。
しっかりとした性格の持ち主で、仕事ではやり手として名を馳せるが、冷徹なキャリアウーマン的な雰囲気は全くなく温厚な接し方で、みなのやる気や士気を高めていくタイプ。
共働きで息子の那智の面倒を見てやれないことに悩むこともあったが、天城フーズの社長の娘で、お向かいさんでもある里奈が、那智の面倒を見てくれた為、申し訳ないと思いつつも夫共に仕事を続けてきた。
幼い頃からよく遊びに来ていた里奈のことを自分の娘のように思い、強い信頼を寄せていて、一人息子である那智を安心して預けていた。
夫婦で活躍していたが天城フーズの電撃倒産を受け、仕事を辞めて家事に専念することにした。
天城フーズが倒産し、里奈がいなくなったことで、なにかに取り付かれ科のように勉学と武道に打ち込む那智の様子に不安を覚えるが、夫である智史と共に息子を信じて、見守ることにした。
A childhood friend who lives directly across the street from the main character, Nachi Mizusawa.
Her father runs the largest local food company, Tenjou Foods, and she is the daughter of the president. She is an only child and has no siblings.

She is a kind, quiet, beautiful, and talented girl with good grades, her personality make her easy to get to know and sit down with. She is wealthy and modest, and does not give off an air of superiority. She has a good appearance, and above all, she has beautiful large breasts, which are said to be the best in school.

She loves the main character whom she has known since childhood, since they live across the street from each other. She treats him as if he were her own younger brother. she is unaware that she spoils Nachi because of her nature.
Because her house is close to the beach, she and Nachi have been going to the beach for a long time.

She loves swimming and is good at it. She wanted to join the school swimming club but didn't considering the home circumstances of both her and Nachi. Instead, she invited Nachi to join a swimming club at a nearby public pool about three days a week after school.

Because she is the daughter of the Tenjou Foods, few boys have confessed their feelings for her, and all the boys who did were rejected. Her reason for refusal is that deep down she is angry that Nachi hasn't made a move yet.
From official site

The business of Tenjou Foods, which was run by her father, rapidly deteriorated. Part of the business was transferred to a Tokyo-based company known as “Sakunamite", Her family moved to Tokyo in order to revive the business. However, Tenjou Foods went bankrupt with only the food distribution division being taken over.

The dream of reviving the business completely disappears. Rina's father becomes ill, due to continued heartache and the shattering of his dreams. Rina is admitted into college, but life is hard having to work, take care of her father, and study.

Then, Yasuhito Sakurada, one of the grandsons of the chairman of “Sakunamite,” takes a shine to her and asks her to marry him. At first, Rina refused, but Yasuhito offered financial support, suggesting that she could stay at home as a full-time housewife without having to work part-time and could instead take care of her father.
Completely exhausted both physically and mentally, and considering her father's worsening health, Rina accepted Yasuhito’s marriage proposal and became his wife.

They leave their shabby apartment and are welcomed into Yasuhito's home as his wife, and begin to live together as husband and wife. However, within three months of their union, she discovered that Yasuhito had several mistresses. When asked about it, Yasuhito responded that he could do whatever he wanted with his money. Rina began regretting how easily she agreed to the marriage. Although dissatisfied, she continued caring for her father.

Yasuhito's behaviour continued to get worse by the day, and would not return home for days at a time. To add insult to injury, her father is diagnosed with liver cancer. All sorts of medication and surgeries were tried, but it had already metastasized and was too late for him. 6 months after diagnosis, he had passed away.

With Rina's father now gone, she feels suffocated living with Yasuhito and leaves home to live separately. The relationship has fully deteriorated. Rina returns to her shabby apartment, but Yasuhito does not agree to divorce, rather he wants to keep her as part of his mistress collection. Rina is unsettled by this, not knowing what his intentions are.

Rina thought that she needs to continue living for her parents who had passed away unexpectedly, and that running away from the painful reality would not solve anything. She is determined to make a new life for herself. Rina reunites with Nachi who had been searching for her, and the two begin a new life with each other.
From official site
